# nemau_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)

A managed Kubernetes cluster, driven by Cluster API.

The API addresses a cluster by name: `id` and `name` are the same value.

`kubernetes_version` and `control_plane_replicas` change in place. Changing `kubernetes_version` starts a guided upgrade, which requires the `kubernetes-guided-upgrades` organization feature: one task runs the preflight checks, opens a maintenance window and starts the upgrade. Apply waits for that task, which completes once the upgrade has started; the nodes keep being replaced after apply returns. A preflight with blocking checks fails the apply and leaves the cluster unchanged. When the version and the node counts change in the same apply, the upgrade runs first. Changing the control-plane node size replaces the cluster.

A cluster is created with one node pool, the `default_node_pool` block, which the API requires. Its `replicas` and autoscaler bounds change in place; changing its name, class or node size replaces the cluster. Declare further pools as `nemau_kubernetes_node_pool` resources, and do not declare the default pool a second time.

Provisioning takes several minutes, and the provider waits until the task completes.

A cluster imports by name. An imported cluster adopts its first node pool, the one created with it, as `default_node_pool`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_kubernetes_cluster" "prod" {
  name               = "prod"
  kubernetes_version = "v1.30.4"

  control_plane_vcpus    = 4
  control_plane_ram_mb   = 8192
  control_plane_disk_gb  = 80
  control_plane_replicas = 3

  default_node_pool {
    name     = "workers"
    vcpus    = 4
    ram_mb   = 8192
    disk_gb  = 100
    replicas = 3
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kubernetes_version` (String) Target version, `x.y.z` with or without a leading `v`. See the `nemau_kubernetes_versions` data source. Changing it upgrades the cluster in place.
- `name` (String) Cluster name. Changing it replaces the cluster.

### Optional

- `cluster_class` (String) Cluster API ClusterClass the cluster is built from. When omitted, the platform's default class is used. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `control_plane_disk_gb` (Number) Disk of each control-plane node, in GB. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `control_plane_flavor_id` (String) Control-plane flavor id. Mutually exclusive with the custom size. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `control_plane_ram_mb` (Number) Memory of each control-plane node, in MB. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `control_plane_replicas` (Number) Number of control-plane nodes, 1 to 9, 3 by default as in the console. Use an odd number: etcd needs a quorum. Changes in place.
- `control_plane_vcpus` (Number) vCPUs of each control-plane node. Set it with `control_plane_ram_mb` and `control_plane_disk_gb`, or use `control_plane_flavor_id`. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `default_node_pool` (Block, Optional) The node pool created with the cluster (required). The node size is `flavor_id`, or all three of `vcpus`, `ram_mb` and `disk_gb`, or nothing when the cluster sets `worker_flavor_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--default_node_pool))
- `worker_flavor_id` (String) Flavor id used by a `default_node_pool` that sets no size of its own. Changing it replaces the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `control_plane_ready` (Boolean) True once the control plane is ready.
- `endpoint` (String) The API server's `host:port`, empty until it is ready.
- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase as reported by the platform. Shows the progress of an upgrade on the next refresh.

<a id="nestedblock--default_node_pool"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_node_pool`

Required:

- `name` (String) A DNS label: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 63 characters at most. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of nodes, 0 to 100. Changes in place.

Optional:

- `autoscaler_max` (Number) Autoscaler upper bound, at most 100. Declare it alongside `autoscaler_min`. Changes in place.
- `autoscaler_min` (Number) Autoscaler lower bound, at least 1. Declare it alongside `autoscaler_max`. Changes in place.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk of each node, in GB. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `flavor_id` (String) Node flavor id. Mutually exclusive with the custom size. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `node_class` (String) The node class the ClusterClass defines; `default-worker` when not set, as in the console. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `ram_mb` (Number) Memory of each node, in MB. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `vcpus` (Number) vCPUs of each node, set together with `ram_mb` and `disk_gb`. Changing it replaces the cluster.

## Import

```shell
# A cluster imports by its name. Its first node pool, the one created with
# it, becomes default_node_pool.
terraform import nemau_kubernetes_cluster.prod prod
```
